blocks.text: Qizil kitobda ba'zi fe'llardan keyin **to** ham, **-ing** ham kelishi mumkinligini ko'rganmiz: It started **to rain** = It started **raining** (→ qizil kitob, 52-dars). Lekin bir guruh fe'llarda tanlov **ma'noni o'zgartiradi**: **remember**, **forget**, **regret**, **stop**, **go on**. Hammasi uchun bitta kalit bor — vaqt tartibi. **-ing** — harakat asosiy fe'ldan **oldin** bo'lgan yoki allaqachon mavjud (orqaga qarash). **to** — harakat asosiy fe'ldan **keyin** bo'ladi (oldinga qarash). I **remember locking** the door — qulfladim, endi buni eslayman. **Remember to lock** the door — avval eslaysan, keyin qulflaysan.

**remember doing** — xotira, o'tgan voqeani eslash: «-ganimni eslayman». **remember to do** — qilish kerak bo'lgan ishni esdan chiqarmaslik: «-ishni unutma», «-ishni esladingmi?». **forget to do** — juda ko'p ishlatiladi: I **forgot to call** her — «Unga qo'ng'iroq qilishni unutibman» (qo'ng'iroq bo'lmadi). **forget doing** esa asosan **I'll never forget ...** qolipida — unutilmas xotira: I'll never **forget seeing** the sea for the first time. O'zbekchada farq aniq: «-gan**ini** eslayman» → -ing; «-ish**ni** unutma» → to.

rows: I **remember meeting** him in 2019. — Uni uchratganimni eslayman.
**Remember to call** him at six. — Soat oltida unga qo'ng'iroq qilishni unutma.
I'll never **forget seeing** the sea. — Dengizni ko'rganimni unutmayman.
I **forgot to buy** bread. — Non olishni unutibman.
I **regret saying** that. — Buni aytganimga afsusdaman.
We **regret to inform** you ... — Afsus bilan ma'lum qilamiz ...
He **stopped to smoke**. — Chekish uchun to'xtadi.
She **went on talking**. — Gapirishda davom etdi.
She **went on to talk** about prices. — So'ng narxlar haqida gapirishga o'tdi.

items.text: I **remember switching off** the oven, so don't worry.
**Remember to switch off** the oven before you go to bed.
I'll never **forget flying** over the mountains in that tiny plane.
items.translation: O'sha kichkina samolyotda tog'lar ustidan **uchganimni** hech qachon **unutmayman**.

blocks.text: **regret doing** (yoki **regret having done**) — o'tgan ishdan afsuslanish: I **regret buying** this car — «Bu mashinani olganimga afsusdaman». **regret not doing** — qilinmagan ish uchun afsus: I **regret not studying** harder. **regret to say / tell / inform / announce** — rasmiy uslubda yomon xabarni yetkazish: We **regret to inform** you that ... — «Afsus bilan ma'lum qilamiz ...». Bu ikkinchi shakl deyarli faqat shu to'rt fe'l bilan keladi va xatlar, e'lonlarda uchraydi. O'tmishdagi ish haqida afsusni **I wish I had ...** bilan ham aytish mumkin (→ 40-dars).

**stop doing** — harakatni to'xtatish, tashlash: He **stopped smoking** — «Chekishni tashladi». **stop to do** — boshqa narsa qilish **uchun** to'xtash; bu yerda **to** maqsadni bildiradi: He **stopped to smoke** — «Chekish uchun to'xtadi» (ya'ni chekdi!). Ma'no qarama-qarshi bo'lgani uchun bu farq juda muhim. O'zbekchada: «-ishni to'xtatdi / bas qildi / tashladi» → -ing; «-ish **uchun** to'xtadi» → to.
go on: davom etish yoki keyingi bosqich

**go on doing** — o'sha ishni davom ettirish (= carry on, continue): She **went on talking** — «Gapirishda davom etdi». **go on to do** — bir ishni tugatib, **keyingisiga** o'tish: After the introduction, she **went on to talk** about prices — «Kirishdan so'ng narxlar haqida gapirishga o'tdi». Hayot yo'li haqida juda ko'p ishlatiladi: He **went on to become** a minister — «Keyinchalik vazir bo'ldi». O'zbekchada «so'ng», «keyinchalik» so'zlari go on to ni yaxshi beradi.

items.text: I **regret lending** him my car — he returned it with a huge scratch.
items.translation: Unga mashinamni **berganimga afsusdaman** — katta tirnalgan holda qaytardi.

items.text: The driver **stopped to fill up** with petrol near Jizzakh.
items.translation: Haydovchi Jizzax yaqinida **benzin quyish uchun to'xtadi**.

items.text: After the break, the lecturer **went on to talk** about the economy of China.
items.translation: Tanaffusdan keyin ma'ruzachi Xitoy iqtisodiyoti haqida **gapirishga o'tdi**.

blocks.text: Ma'no o'zgarmaydi: begin, start, continue, intend, bother

**begin, start, continue, intend, bother** dan keyin to ham, -ing ham keladi va ma'no deyarli bir xil: Prices **continued to rise** = Prices **continued rising**. **bother** — «ovora bo'lmoq», ko'pincha inkorda: Don't **bother to reply** / **replying** — «Javob berib ovora bo'lmang». Ikkita istisno bor. (1) start / begin ning o'zi -ing shaklida bo'lsa, ikki -ing ketma-ket kelmasin: It's **starting to rain** («It's starting raining» — noto'g'ri). (2) **understand, realise, know** kabi bilish fe'llari bilan faqat to: I **began to understand** the problem.

items.text: It **began raining** just as the match started.
The company **intends to open** a branch in Tashkent next spring.
items.translation: Kompaniya kelasi bahorda Toshkentda filial **ochish niyatida**.

items.text: I'm **starting to feel** better after three days in bed.
items.translation: Uch kun yotgandan keyin o'zimni yaxshiroq **his qila boshlayapman**.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I remember to see him last year.» → I **remember seeing** him last year.; «Don't forget locking the door.» → Don't **forget to lock** the door.; «I stopped to smoke» (tashladim ma'nosida) → I **stopped smoking**.; «We stopped for buying water.» → We **stopped to buy** water.; «I regret to tell her the truth» (aytib qo'ydim, afsusdaman) → I **regret telling** her the truth.; «It's starting raining.» → It's **starting to rain**.

Vaqt chizig'ini tasavvur qiling: **-ing ← orqaga** (harakat allaqachon bo'lgan: eslayman, afsusdaman, tashladim), **to → oldinga** (harakat hali bo'ladi: unutma, ... uchun to'xtadi, keyin ... ga o'tdi). O'zbekchada «-gan» bo'lsa — deyarli doim -ing; «-ish uchun» yoki «-ishni unutma» bo'lsa — to.

rows: ma'no bir xil (is starting / understand — faqat to)

examples.title: Memories: **remember doing**, **never forget doing**
examples.description: -ing — harakat oldin bo'lgan, biz uni eslaymiz yoki unutmaymiz. O'zbekchada «-ganimni eslayman», «-ganini hech qachon unutmaydi».

sentences.text: I clearly **remember meeting** Sarah at a conference in Oxford ten years ago.
sentences.translation: O'n yil oldin Oksforddagi konferensiyada Sara bilan **tanishganimni** aniq **eslayman**.

sentences.text: Do you **remember going** to the zoo with Grandpa when you were six?
sentences.translation: Olti yoshligingda bobong bilan hayvonot bog'iga **borganingni eslaysanmi**?

sentences.text: I'll never **forget standing** on top of the mountain and seeing the whole valley below.
sentences.translation: Tog' cho'qqisida **turganimni** va pastdagi butun vodiyni ko'rganimni hech qachon **unutmayman**.

sentences.text: Jasur doesn't **remember saying** that, but everyone heard him.
sentences.translation: Jasur buni **aytganini eslamaydi**, lekin hamma eshitgan.

sentences.text: Most people **remember feeling** nervous before their first job interview.
sentences.translation: Ko'pchilik birinchi ish suhbatidan oldin **hayajonlanganini eslaydi**.

sentences.text: My grandmother still **remembers queuing** for bread when she was a girl.
sentences.translation: Buvim qizligida non uchun **navbatda turganini** hali ham **eslaydi**.

sentences.text: Sorry, I **don't remember** you **lending** me any money — are you sure it was me?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, menga **qarz berganingizni eslay olmayapman** — men ekanimga ishonchingiz komilmi?

sentences.text: Kate will never **forget hearing** the news that she had won the scholarship.
sentences.translation: Keyt grantni yutgani haqidagi xabarni **eshitgan lahzasini** hech qachon **unutmaydi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod vaguely **remembers having seen** the man somewhere before.
sentences.translation: Bekzod bu odamni oldin qayerdadir **ko'rganini** g'ira-shira **eslaydi**.

sentences.text: I **remember my father teaching** me to ride a bike in our yard in Fergana.
sentences.translation: Dadamning Farg'onadagi hovlimizda menga velosiped haydashni **o'rgatganini eslayman**.

examples.title: Things to do: **remember to**, **forget to**
examples.description: to — harakat keyin bo'ladi: qilish kerak bo'lgan ishni eslash yoki unutish. O'zbekchada «-ishni unutma», «-ishni unutibman».

sentences.text: **Remember to take** your passport — you can't check in without it.
sentences.translation: Pasportingni **olishni unutma** — usiz ro'yxatdan o'ta olmaysan.

sentences.text: I **forgot to charge** my phone, so it died in the middle of the call.
sentences.translation: Telefonimni **zaryadlashni unutibman**, shuning uchun suhbat o'rtasida o'chib qoldi.

sentences.text: Did you **remember to send** Emma a birthday card? — Oh no, I completely forgot!
sentences.translation: Emmaga tug'ilgan kun tabrignomasini **yuborishni esladingmi**? — Voy, butunlay unutibman!

sentences.text: Please **don't forget to switch off** the lights when you leave the office.
sentences.translation: Ofisdan chiqayotganda chiroqlarni **o'chirishni unutmang**.

sentences.text: Aziz never **remembers to water** the plants, so they're all dying.
sentences.translation: Aziz hech qachon gullarga **suv quyishni eslamaydi**, shuning uchun ularning hammasi qurib qolyapti.

sentences.text: Someone **forgot to lock** the back door, and a cat got into the kitchen.
sentences.translation: Kimdir orqa eshikni **qulflashni unutibdi**, oshxonaga mushuk kirib qolibdi.

sentences.text: **Remember to back up** your files before you install the update.
sentences.translation: Yangilanishni o'rnatishdan oldin fayllaringizning **zaxira nusxasini olishni unutmang**.

sentences.text: Madina **forgot to mention** that the meeting had been moved to Tuesday.
sentences.translation: Madina yig'ilish seshanbaga ko'chirilganini **aytishni unutibdi**.

sentences.text: Have you **remembered to book** a table, or will we have to queue?
sentences.translation: Stol **band qilishni esladingmi** yoki navbatda turishimizga to'g'ri keladimi?

sentences.text: If you **forget to renew** your parking permit, you'll get a fine.
sentences.translation: Avtoturargoh ruxsatnomangizni **yangilashni unutsangiz**, jarimaga tortilasiz.

examples.title: Contrast: **remember doing** or **remember to do**?
examples.description: Juft gaplar: bir xil fe'l, ikki xil ma'no. -ing — o'tgan harakatni eslash, to — bajarilishi kerak bo'lgan harakat.

sentences.text: I **remember locking** the door — I checked it twice before I left.
sentences.translation: Eshikni **qulflaganimni eslayman** — chiqishdan oldin ikki marta tekshirdim.

sentences.text: Next time, please **remember to lock** the door — someone could walk in.
sentences.translation: Keyingi safar eshikni **qulflashni unutmang** — birov kirib qolishi mumkin.

sentences.text: Tom **remembers posting** the letter, but it never arrived.
sentences.translation: Tom xatni **jo'natganini eslaydi**, lekin xat hech qachon yetib bormadi.

sentences.text: Did Tom **remember to post** the letter, or is it still in his bag?
sentences.translation: Tom xatni **jo'natishni esladimi** yoki u hali ham sumkasidami?

sentences.text: I'll never **forget meeting** my favourite writer at the book festival in London.
sentences.translation: London kitob festivalida sevimli yozuvchim bilan **uchrashganimni** hech qachon **unutmayman**.

sentences.text: Oh no, I **forgot to meet** my sister at the station!
sentences.translation: Voy, singlimni vokzalda **kutib olishni unutibman**!

sentences.text: Do you **remember telling** me this story before? You've told it three times!
sentences.translation: Bu voqeani menga avval **aytib berganingni eslaysanmi**? Uch marta aytding-ku!

sentences.text: Please **remember to tell** your manager that you'll be late tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Ertaga kechikishingizni rahbaringizga **aytishni unutmang**.

sentences.text: Nilufar **remembers paying** the electricity bill, but the company says it hasn't received the money.
sentences.translation: Nilufar elektr uchun **to'laganini eslaydi**, lekin kompaniya pulni olmaganini aytyapti.

sentences.text: This month she **forgot to pay** the gas bill, so she got a warning letter.
sentences.translation: Bu oy esa gaz uchun **to'lashni unutib**, ogohlantirish xati oldi.

examples.title: **regret doing** / **regret to say**
examples.description: regret -ing / not -ing / having done — o'tgan ish uchun afsus. regret to say / inform / announce — rasmiy uslubda yomon xabar.

sentences.text: I **regret not learning** to play the piano when I was a child.
sentences.translation: Bolaligimda pianino chalishni **o'rganmaganimdan afsuslanaman**.

sentences.text: We **regret to inform** you that your application has not been successful.
sentences.translation: Arizangiz qabul qilinmaganini **afsus bilan ma'lum qilamiz**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **regrets selling** his old car — the new one keeps breaking down.
sentences.translation: Bekzod eski mashinasini **sotganiga afsuslanyapti** — yangisi tez-tez buzilib turibdi.

sentences.text: Do you ever **regret moving** to Manchester, or are you happy there?
sentences.translation: Manchesterga **ko'chganingizdan** hech **afsuslanasizmi** yoki u yerda baxtlimisiz?

sentences.text: The airline **regrets to announce** that flight BA 214 has been cancelled.
sentences.translation: Aviakompaniya BA 214 reysi bekor qilinganini **afsus bilan e'lon qiladi**.

sentences.text: Sarah later **regretted telling** her colleagues about her plans to leave.
sentences.translation: Keyinchalik Sara hamkasblariga ketish rejalari haqida **aytganidan pushaymon bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: I **regret to say** that the situation has got worse since last week.
sentences.translation: **Afsus bilan aytishim kerakki**, o'tgan haftadan beri vaziyat yomonlashdi.

sentences.text: You'll **regret not taking** this opportunity — offers like this don't come often.
sentences.translation: Bu imkoniyatdan **foydalanmaganingizga afsuslanasiz** — bunday takliflar tez-tez bo'lmaydi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **regrets having spent** so much money on her wedding.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza to'yiga shuncha pul **sarflaganidan afsuslanadi**.

sentences.text: Many graduates **regret choosing** a subject just because their friends chose it.
sentences.translation: Ko'p bitiruvchilar faqat do'stlari tanlagani uchun yo'nalish **tanlaganidan afsuslanadi**.

examples.title: **stop doing** / **stop to do**
examples.description: stop -ing — harakatni to'xtatish, tashlash. stop to do — boshqa ish qilish uchun to'xtash (to — maqsad, «... uchun»).

sentences.text: My uncle **stopped eating** sugar after his doctor warned him about diabetes.
sentences.translation: Shifokor qandli diabet haqida ogohlantirganidan keyin amakim **shakar yeyishni tashladi**.

sentences.text: On the way to Samarkand we **stopped to buy** some fresh bread and melons.
sentences.translation: Samarqandga ketayotib yangi non va qovun **olish uchun to'xtadik**.

sentences.text: Has it **stopped raining**? — Yes, I think we can go out now.
sentences.translation: Yomg'ir **tindimi**? — Ha, menimcha endi tashqariga chiqsa bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Halfway through the speech, the minister **stopped to drink** some water.
sentences.translation: Nutqning yarmida vazir biroz **suv ichish uchun to'xtadi**.

sentences.text: Please **stop checking** your phone — we're trying to have a conversation!
sentences.translation: Iltimos, **telefoningga qarayverishni bas qil** — biz gaplashmoqchimiz!

sentences.text: We **stopped to ask** a police officer for directions because the satnav wasn't working.
sentences.translation: Navigator ishlamagani uchun politsiyachidan **yo'l so'rash uchun to'xtadik**.

sentences.text: The baby finally **stopped crying** at about three in the morning.
sentences.translation: Chaqaloq nihoyat tungi soat uchlarda **yig'idan to'xtadi**.

sentences.text: Oliver **stopped to look** at the view, and his friends walked on without him.
sentences.translation: Oliver manzaraga **qarash uchun to'xtadi**, do'stlari esa usiz yo'lda davom etishdi.

sentences.text: Why did you **stop going** to the gym? — It got too expensive.
sentences.translation: Nega sport zaliga **borishni to'xtatding**? — Juda qimmatlashib ketdi.

sentences.text: Nobody **stopped to help** the old man who had fallen on the icy pavement.
sentences.translation: Muz qoplagan yo'lakda yiqilib tushgan qariyaga **yordam berish uchun** hech kim **to'xtamadi**.

examples.title: **go on doing** / **go on to do**
examples.description: go on -ing — o'sha ishni davom ettirish. go on to do — bir ishdan keyin yangisiga o'tish; hayot yo'li haqida «keyinchalik ... bo'ldi».

sentences.text: The band **went on playing** even after the electricity went off.
sentences.translation: Elektr o'chib qolganidan keyin ham guruh **chalishda davom etdi**.

sentences.text: After studying medicine in Tashkent, Madina **went on to work** for the World Health Organization.
sentences.translation: Toshkentda tibbiyot o'qigan Madina **keyinchalik** Jahon sog'liqni saqlash tashkilotida **ishladi**.

sentences.text: The teacher introduced herself and then **went on to explain** the rules of the course.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi o'zini tanishtirdi, so'ng kurs qoidalarini **tushuntirishga o'tdi**.

sentences.text: If you **go on spending** like this, you'll have no money left by the end of the month.
sentences.translation: Agar shunday **sarflashda davom etsangiz**, oy oxiriga borib pulingiz qolmaydi.

sentences.text: He was a shy boy from a small village who **went on to become** a famous actor.
sentences.translation: U kichik qishloqdan chiqqan uyatchan bola edi, **keyinchalik** esa mashhur aktyor **bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: Despite the noise from the street, Emma **went on working** until midnight.
sentences.translation: Ko'chadagi shovqinga qaramay, Emma yarim tungacha **ishlashda davom etdi**.

sentences.text: The report describes the problem and **goes on to suggest** three possible solutions.
sentences.translation: Hisobot muammoni tasvirlaydi, **so'ng** uchta yechimni **taklif qiladi**.

sentences.text: How long can prices **go on rising** before people stop buying?
sentences.translation: Odamlar xarid qilishni to'xtatmaguncha narxlar qancha vaqt **o'sishda davom etishi** mumkin?

sentences.text: Oliver won the regional chess championship and **went on to win** the national title.
sentences.translation: Oliver viloyat shaxmat chempionatida g'olib bo'ldi, **so'ng** milliy chempionlikni ham **qo'lga kiritdi**.

sentences.text: She paused for a moment, then **went on talking** as if nothing had happened.
sentences.translation: U bir zum to'xtadi-yu, so'ng hech narsa bo'lmagandek **gapirishda davom etdi**.

examples.title: No change: **begin**, **start**, **continue**, **bother**
examples.description: Bu fe'llardan keyin to ham, -ing ham keladi, ma'no bir xil. Istisnolar: is starting **to**, begin **to understand / realise**.

sentences.text: The audience **began clapping** before the singer had even finished.
sentences.translation: Qo'shiqchi hali tugatmasidan tomoshabinlar **qarsak chala boshladi**.

sentences.text: Prices **continued to rise** throughout the year, despite the government's promises.
sentences.translation: Hukumatning va'dalariga qaramay, narxlar yil davomida **o'sishda davom etdi**.

sentences.text: It's **starting to get** dark — we should head back to the hotel.
sentences.translation: **Qorong'i tusha boshladi** — mehmonxonaga qaytishimiz kerak.

sentences.text: When did you **start learning** English? — At primary school in Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Ingliz tilini qachon **o'rgana boshlagansiz**? — Buxorodagi boshlang'ich maktabda.

sentences.text: I **intend to complain** to the manager about the way we were treated.
sentences.translation: Bizga qanday munosabatda bo'lishgani haqida menejerga **shikoyat qilmoqchiman**.

sentences.text: Don't **bother cooking** tonight — I'll bring some food home from the restaurant.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun **ovqat qilib ovora bo'lma** — restorandan ovqat olib kelaman.

sentences.text: After a few weeks in London, Aziz **began to understand** the local accent.
sentences.translation: Londonda bir necha hafta yashagach, Aziz mahalliy talaffuzni **tushuna boshladi**.

sentences.text: Despite the rain, the fans **continued singing** until the end of the match.
sentences.translation: Yomg'irga qaramay, muxlislar o'yin oxirigacha **qo'shiq aytishda davom etishdi**.

sentences.text: He didn't even **bother to say** goodbye when he left the company.
sentences.translation: Kompaniyadan ketayotganda u hatto **xayrlashib ham o'tirmadi**.

sentences.text: I'm **beginning to realise** how much my parents did for me.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam men uchun qanchalik ko'p ish qilganini endi **anglay boshlayapman**.

examples.title: Mixed: memories, regrets and new beginnings
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: remember, forget, regret, stop, go on, begin — bir gapda ikki shakl ham uchraydi.

sentences.text: I **remember promising** to call you, but I **forgot to write** down your number.
sentences.translation: Senga qo'ng'iroq qilishga **va'da berganimni eslayman**, lekin raqamingni **yozib olishni unutibman**.

sentences.text: Halfway to Khiva we **stopped to rest**, and Jasur finally **stopped complaining** about the heat.
sentences.translation: Xivaga yarim yo'lda **dam olish uchun to'xtadik**, Jasur ham nihoyat issiqdan **nolishni bas qildi**.

sentences.text: Emma **regrets not going** to university, but she **went on to build** a successful business.
sentences.translation: Emma universitetga **bormaganidan afsuslanadi**, lekin **keyinchalik** muvaffaqiyatli biznes **qurdi**.

sentences.text: Did you **remember to cancel** the hotel booking, or will they charge us?
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona bronini **bekor qilishni esladingmi** yoki bizdan pul yechib olishadimi?

sentences.text: My grandfather **went on working** in his garden until he was ninety.
sentences.translation: Bobom to'qson yoshgacha bog'ida **ishlashda davom etdi**.

sentences.text: We **regret to tell** you that the concert has been postponed until May.
sentences.translation: Konsert mayga ko'chirilganini **afsus bilan ma'lum qilamiz**.

sentences.text: James will never **forget winning** his first race at the age of nine.
sentences.translation: Jeyms to'qqiz yoshida birinchi poygasida **g'olib bo'lganini** hech qachon **unutmaydi**.

sentences.text: Once the speaker **started to answer** questions, the audience **began to relax**.
sentences.translation: Ma'ruzachi savollarga **javob bera boshlagach**, tomoshabinlar **bo'shasha boshladi**.

sentences.text: Please **stop worrying** about the exam — you've prepared really well.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, imtihon haqida **xavotirlanishni bas qiling** — juda yaxshi tayyorlangansiz.

sentences.text: Kate **didn't remember meeting** Tom before, although he remembered her very clearly.
sentences.translation: Keyt Tom bilan oldin **uchrashganini eslamadi**, Tom esa uni juda aniq eslardi.
